issues.description: globCache key is filename-only but value depends on changedFiles, violating cache invariant
issues.detail: isIncluded caches results keyed solely by filename, but the verdict now also depends on changedFiles state. onTestRunStart clears the cache, but any call before that hook fires poisons the cache with an unfiltered verdict. Either include changedFiles identity in the key, or separate the pure glob match from the changed-file filter applied after.

issues.description: Path normalization invariant between changedFiles and filename is unstated and unenforced
issues.detail: isIncluded compares slash(cleanUrl(filename)) against changedFiles entries from two upstream sources (VitestGit.findChangedFiles, config.related) with no documented path-form invariant. Windows separators, query strings, or relative-vs-absolute mismatches silently filter everything out. Normalize on entry to changedFiles and assert the invariant.

issues.description: changedFiles is mutable provider state, complecting lifecycle with isIncluded's answer
issues.detail: onTestRunStart mutates this.changedFiles as a side effect; isIncluded's answer depends on whether the hook already ran. Two different sources (options.changed vs ctx.config.related) are conflated under one field with implicit precedence. Resolve a single immutable ChangedFilesSet at config-resolve time and pass it explicitly into isIncluded/getUntestedFiles.

issues.description: findChangedFiles null result silently disables filter and reports unrestricted coverage
issues.detail: When vitestGit.findChangedFiles returns null (not a git repo, ref missing), this.changedFiles becomes undefined and coverage silently reports everything. The user's requested postcondition is 'coverage limited to changed files'; the implementation degrades to unrestricted on git failure with no test exercising the null branch. Warn or fail rather than silently fall back.

issues.description: onTestRunStart invoked from three duplicated call sites in core.ts with no shared helper
issues.detail: core.ts calls coverageProvider?.onTestRunStart?.() in three places after _testRun.start, with the invariant carried only by convention. A fourth code path will silently skip coverage filtering. Extract a single private helper or document the invariant on the interface so the ordering is enforceable by reading one function.

issues.description: CLI transform silently coerces ambiguous strings without validation or stated grammar
issues.detail: The transform special-cases 'true'/'yes'/'false'/'no' and passes everything else through as a git ref. Typos like 'tru' or 'flase' become refs that fail later inside VitestGit with confusing errors, and literal refs named true/false are unreachable. Validate input shape at the boundary and document the precedence rule.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the feature is small and works on the happy path, but the implementation has not been reasoned end-to-end. The central correctness problem is that globCache's key no longer determines its value once changedFiles is in play, and the path-normalization invariant between changedFiles entries and isIncluded's filename is unstated across two upstream sources. Mutable provider state and a silent null-fallback when git fails further weaken the postcondition the user asked for. Three duplicated onTestRunStart call sites in core.ts and an unvalidated CLI string-or-boolean coercion round out the cleanup list.
